name: opening_spread
definition: seller_open - buyer_open: distance between the two sides' first priced proposals

name: anchor_distance
definition: |own opening price - own scenario target|: how far the opener anchored from its brief target

name: n_concessions
definition: count of the focal side's own moves in the conceding direction across proposal rounds

name: mean_concession
definition: mean |price step| of the focal side's conceding moves (USD)

name: concession_rate
definition: focal side's total concession / number of proposal rounds (USD per round)

name: buyer_share_concession
definition: buyer total concession / (buyer + seller total concession)

name: n_proposal_rounds
definition: count of priced submit_proposal calls in the session

name: turns_to_deal
definition: turn number of the accept that closed an agreed session (NaN if no deal)
